title: An Adaptive-Horizon Graph Neural Operator for coupled surrogate morphodynamic modelling
abstract: arXiv:2610.22432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Morphodynamic simulations require repeated coupling between hydrodynamic solvers, sediment transport modules, and bed updating. For long duration, multi-scenario simulations on large unstructured meshes, such coupling is computationally demanding. This study proposes an Adaptive-Horizon Graph Neural Operator (AH-GNO) that formulates bed evolution as a graph operator learning problem from recent hydrodynamic and topographic states to predict future bed elevation increments. The model operates directly on the native unstructured meshes. The approach integrates area-weighted graph learning, historical state selection, and forecast horizon estimation, allowing the effective history length (K) and update interval (B) to vary with the evolving flow and bed state. translated_title: 一种用于耦合代理地貌动力学建模的自适应时域图神经算子
translated_abstract: 地貌动力学模拟需要水动力求解器、泥沙输移模块与河床更新之间的反复耦合。对于在大规模非结构网格上进行的长历时、多情景模拟而言，这种耦合在计算上代价高昂。本研究提出一种自适应时域图神经算子（AH-GNO），将河床演变表述为一个图算子学习问题，从近期的水动力和地形状态出发预测未来的河床高程增量。该模型直接在原始非结构网格上运行。该方法融合了面积加权图学习、历史状态选择和预报时域估计，使有效历史长度（K）和更新间隔（B）能够随流动与河床状态的演变而自适应变化。以Telemac2D/GAIA求解结果作为监督数值参考，该框架在官方Bump和Yen弯道基准算例以及一个现场尺度应用（Waiho河）上进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出自适应时域图神经算子AH-GNO，直接在非结构网格上从水动力与地形状态学习预测河床高程增量，并能根据流动和河床演变自适应调整历史长度与更新间隔，从而实现高效的地貌动力学耦合代理建模。
